svg.text: erd Full schema of the SWE5006 monolith (Flyway V1–V28, schema domain), by owning context
FK* = logical foreign key; integrity is application-managed
(team DDL convention: no FK / CHECK constraints). PK: UUIDv7.
→ target: the referenced table; lines drawn inside a context only.
partial = unique WHERE deleted = false (or the stated predicate).
Crow's foot: || one · o| zero or one · |< one or many · o< zero or many.
Frame colour = ADR 0008 service ownership (red commerce, cobalt
identity / notification, grey shared). Mapper folder = owner.
